title: 1.6 Parents and Grandparents
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Name the father, the mother, the parents, and the grandparents, and connect grandparents with their grandchildren.
grammar_function: The + role; He/She is the + role; They are the + plural role; The + group and the + group.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.4-1.5: family, children, an adult, and adults.
speaking_outcome: Identify the father, the mother, the parents, the grandfather, the grandmother, and the grandparents with their grandchildren.
